name: puntos-carga
description: App unificada de puntos de recarga de vehículos eléctricos (España + Europa)

scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/shared packages/pricing packages/dataset packages/planner packages/db
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run migrate -w @pc/db
scripts.ingest: npm run build:packages && npm run ingest -w @pc/workers --
scripts.status:watch: npm run build:packages && npm run ingest -w @pc/workers -- watch-status pt-mobie
scripts.data:export: npm run build:packages && npm run ingest -w @pc/workers -- export
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @pc/api
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @pc/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
